id: title:haacked:wait for the clickhouse mover instead of stopping the backfill

review.posthog_relevance: Adds disk-reservation and disk-fill safety checks, including a configurable wait-timeout and a dedicated disk-headroom polling loop, to prevent ClickHouse shard backfill from proceeding when disk space is critically low.
review.reason: Adds disk-reservation and disk-fill safety checks, including a configurable wait-timeout and a dedicated disk-headroom polling loop, to prevent ClickHouse shard backfill from proceeding when disk space is critically low.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation of a bounded safety check. However, the actual runtime behavior and whether this prevents a production incident or degraded performance is not demonstrated by the code alone; the benefit is inferred rather than observed.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are supported. No tier assignment is performed.

observations.behavior: Adds disk-reservation and disk-fill safety checks, including a configurable wait-timeout and a dedicated disk-headroom polling loop.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a Dagster backfill DAG configuration field and a runtime check that stops shard backfill if ClickHouse remains below its move_factor reserve for too long, while also checking for blocking runs.
